Trial connection details and matched source member checks are recorded where available. Each unverified design item retains review status.

Form the circular link restraints from certified IS 2062 E250 B0 feedstock with a full-penetration longitudinal seam. IS 1161 Table 1 supplies finished dimensions. Axial design uses 250 MPa yield, 410 MPa tensile and the cold-formed hollow-section buckling curve.

Secondary joists, link flange restraints and connection steel are added to the primary model as 0.90 kN/m² at levels 1–4, 0.75 at level 5, 1.00 at levels 6–7 and 0.60 at the upper roof. The complete 100%-imposed companion envelopes floor-count differences at the five-storey leg and adjoining eight-storey column stacks.
